json.notes: Victorian glasshouse with a white painted timber and glass frame. A tall central dome with a cupola and finial sits on a square pavilion, flanked by two long low wings whose barrel-shaped glazed roofs curve down toward the ends. Small domed end pavilions close the wings, and a brick plinth runs round the base.
